title: Chapter 655 - 655 Discussion; Questioning!

Chapter 655 - 655 Discussion; Questioning!

Chapter 655 - 655 Discussion; Questioning!

655 Discussion; Questioning!

The Initial Fog had given many people special abilities. It had even allowed two of them to become immortals!

The students’ faces were filled with yearning and excitement.

Now that they had also inhaled the Initial Fog, would they also have the chance to become immortals?

If only they had inhaled a little more just now.

“Lin Fan? I suddenly remember that you have the same name as that great man,” Li Dongqiang said.

The surrounding people could not help but cast a strange look.

However, everyone’s expressions quickly returned to normal.

After all, the name Lin Fan was too ordinary. There were at least 8,000 people with the same name in the world.

It could not be that the Lin Fan in front of them was the great man from a thousand years ago, right?

Obviously, this was impossible.

However, they did not know that what they thought was impossible was the truth.

Qin Chuan cleared his throat and said, “Your one-week trip to the forbidden area is now over. Now, take the hover bus back to Jiangbei University.”

“Yes, Teacher!” All the students responded in unison.

The hover bus made a soft sound and moved forward quickly along the winding road.

Qin Chuan and the man in black looked at each other after watching the hover bus leave.

Then, the two of them turned into afterimages and rushed into the depths of the forbidden area.

About half an hour later, the two of them finally arrived at the area where the white fog had appeared.

“What pure energy.”

The man in black looked around and frowned slightly. “But it doesn’t make sense. This place has long been explored, but there were no spiritual veins or spiritual objects in the surroundings. Why did the fog appear?”

Qin Chuan also looked around.

However, he did not think as hard as the man in black.

Instead, he laughed out loud and said, “Perhaps it’s a moving spirit vein, or perhaps it was spiritual energy that descended from the sky… There are many unexplainable things in this world, so why bother?”

“So… our bet is 100,000 World Coins, right?”

As Qin Chuan spoke, he could not help but rub his hands together.

“What 100,000 World Coins?” the man in black said angrily. “It’s 20,000 World Coins!”

“Really?” Qin Chuan asked. “Only 20,000?”

The man in black looked at his suspicious gaze and wanted to punch him.

He was the one wanted to go back on their word and asked if it was 100 World Coins or 50 World Coins.

Now that he won, he said it was 100,000 World Coins?

Qin Chuan seemed to have sensed the unfriendly gaze of the black-robed man. He waved his hand and said, “Alright, alright. 20,000 World Coins it is. Transfer it! You won’t go back on your word, will you?”

The man in black did not say anything and transferred 20,000 World Coins to him.

“Many thanks!” Qin Chuan smiled.

After saying that, he turned into an afterimage and headed straight out of the forbidden area.

At this moment, the man in black suddenly thought of something and shouted, “Qin Chuan, you still owe me 10,000 World Coins!”

However, Qin Chuan was nowhere to be seen.

“Qin Chuan, don’t run!” The man in black shouted.

As soon as he finished speaking, he also ran out of the forbidden area.

…

The news that everyone in Class 2011 had become special ability users spread like wildfire throughout the entire Jiangbei University.

“Have you heard? Class 2011 all have special abilities!”

“Of course, I heard it! Also, I know that the reason why the students of Class 2011 all have special abilities is because they met the legendary god!”

“They encountered a god? But why did I hear that it was because of a spirit mine?”

“How can it be a spirit mine?! That was a rumor spread by others! There are also some spirit mines in this world, but have you ever heard of anyone who got special abilities after encountering a spirit mine? I don’t think so!”

“That’s true…”

“So they must’ve met a god!”

…

At first, all the students of Jiangbei University were envious.

Soon, they began to discuss the reason why the students of Class 2011 became special ability users.

Some said that they had encountered spirit mines, some said that they had encountered immortals, and some said that they had encountered spirit fruits…

All kinds of explanations sounded reasonable in their ears.

It was as if they had seen it happen with their own eyes.

It had to be said that a person’s imagination and ability to make up stories were really rich.

Following that, many people began to apply to the school to enter Forbidden Area No. 31.

Because, no matter what the reason was, they thought they could obtain special abilities too since everyone in Class 2011 made it happen!

Of course, all of this was in vain.

…

Today, Chen Ming wore a white shirt.

He had already thrown his clothes in the forbidden area into the trash can.

Chen Ming was gently tasting the green tea in his hand.

At this moment, Liu Wei from Class 2011 walked over slowly.

When he saw Chen Ming, he seemed to have recalled the scene of Chen Ming being covered in poop and could not help but laugh.

When Chen Ming saw this, he could not help but frown slightly.

He said in a deep voice, “Liu Wei, you’ve been doing a good job in the student union. Now that you’ve become a special ability user, you have a high chance of becoming a high-ranking member of the student union in the future.”

When Liu Wei heard this, his heart could not help but beat faster.

He had indeed become a special ability user.

However, he was only the most ordinary strength ability user.

Moreover, his strength did not increase much.

In this way, becoming a high-ranking member of the student union was extremely attractive to him.

“Thank you for your appreciation, Vice President Chen!” Liu Wei said excitedly.

An unhappy expression flashed across Chen Ming’s face.

Vice President Chen?

If it were in the past, he would have told Liu Wei to get lost.

But now, he still had things to understand.

Chen Ming pretended to be indifferent.

“I heard that everyone in Class 2011 has a special ability? Can you tell me what happened?”

Therefore, Liu Wei told him everything that had happened from beginning to end.

Chen Ming could not help but fall into deep thought.

Initial Fog!

He had heard this name before.

This was something that only existed in legends.

He did not expect to appear in Forbidden Area No. 31!

If he had not been plotted against, he could have also absorbed the Initial Fog and increase the level of his special ability!

Damn it, damn it!

When Chen Ming thought of this, he could not help but clench his fists.

He swore in his heart that he would definitely teach the person who ambushed him an unforgettable lesson.

“Also, uhh…” Liu Wei secretly looked at Chen Ming and stammered.

“Just say it directly,” Chen Ming said lightly. “We, the student union officials, don’t like to hide things.”

When Liu Wei heard this, he said, “When we were in the forbidden area, Lin Fan played a 3D projection video in front of everyone. In the video…”

Speaking up to this point, Liu Wei secretly glanced at Chen Ming.

This time, he continued, “In the video, you were hiding behind a small hill in a very sorry state. Moreover, your body seemed to be… covered in a lot of dirty things.”

Chen Ming’s head suddenly exploded.

A 3D projection was played in public!

‘Lin Fan, you’re courting death!’

Chen Ming’s anger erupted!
